name: Single-file base page with menu and contact sections
purpose: No site file exists. Needed: one HTML file naming Sweet Crumbs Bakery and Pune, with grouped menu and contact sections, responsive on phones.

envelope.stop_loss: Stop if the file is not produced after one retry, or if spend exceeds 25.

outputs: site.html with header, menu section, contact section, responsive CSS, placeholder markers
completion_check: The file opens locally without a server. It contains 'Sweet Crumbs Bakery' and 'Pune', a grouped menu section, and a contact section with address, phone, WhatsApp link and hours. Cake entries show 'starting from' and non-cake entries show a fixed price or a [PLACEHOLDER: ...] marker. A viewport meta tag and a small-screen media query are present. No payment code, fetch or XHR calls, or storage use.

name: Cake order section with WhatsApp prefilled form
purpose: No way to order a cake. Needed: a form that opens a prefilled WhatsApp chat, delivery areas in one editable block, and a manual-confirmation notice.

envelope.stop_loss: Stop if the wa.me submit does not build a message from the form fields after one retry, or if spend exceeds 35.

outputs: site.html updated with cake orders section, order form, WhatsApp submit script, delivery area block, confirmation notice
completion_check: The section is labelled for cake orders and has all required form fields. The submit handler builds a wa.me URL from the field values, with the number as one marked placeholder constant. The delivery area list is a single editable block. The page states that orders are confirmed by the bakery after the WhatsApp message. No fetch, XHR, payment code or localStorage/cookie use. The section stacks on small screens.

name: Fix 360px horizontal overflow in site.html
purpose: At 360px the page overflows horizontally by 61px (desktop 1280px has none), so done-when item 11 (readable on a phone) fails.

envelope.stop_loss: Stop if 360px overflow_px is still above 0 after one retry, or if spend exceeds 8, or if the fix changes any placeholder, form field, wa.me script or area block.

outputs: site.html updated with CSS-only fixes for the overflow, e.g. box-sizing: border-box, max-width: 100% and width: 100% on form controls, min-width: 0 on grid and flex children, overflow-wrap: anywhere on .ph and contact text
completion_check: At a 360px viewport, document scrollWidth equals clientWidth (overflow_px is 0), and desktop 1280px still shows 0 overflow. The viewport meta tag and the max-width: 640px media query are still present. All [PLACEHOLDER] markers, the form fields, the wa.me submit script and the delivery area block are unchanged. No fetch, XHR, storage or payment code is added.
